correctness.rationale: The update preserves identical colors among vertices in the same initial class and color cohort. For clique clones the only exceptional adjacency is to vertices of the same current color, which cannot be a successor. Thus a trajectory on the induced graph of one representative per cohort lifts exactly, and equality of entire representative vectors is equivalent to equality of the actual labelled states. A fresh direct adjacency replay evolved all 225 nonempty palette pairs, found the first repeated full color vector, matched the stated activation criterion in every case and recovered all six coefficient matrices. Substitution of W_i(m)W_j(n) was checked as a formal polynomial identity in the powers of 2, 3 and 4, not only for sampled sizes; the total is 4^{m+n}. The four-cycle states have disjoint sets of four along each orbit and hence N_{0,4}/4 orbits. For n>=2 a singleton clique palette 0 with independent palette {1,2} takes exactly three steps, and clones give all larger admissible sizes. For n=1,m>=2 clique palette {0,1} and independent color 2 take two steps, and the coefficient table excludes third entry. A consecutive-color edge at m=n=1 takes one step and the table excludes more. Finally B_4/4^{m+n} tends at fixed m to [W_4(m)+4W_3(m)+2W_2(m)]/4^m. Both the fixed basin and N_{3,1} have leading term 4(2^m-1)4^n for fixed m, giving the conditional limit; a full clique palette has probability tending to one as m grows, irrespective of n.
residual_risks: The finite check is exhaustive because of the cohort lifting argument, not a sample of large graphs. Neither the census nor the limits are asserted for other update rules or graphs.

value.rationale: The complete split family has a natural clique–independent asymmetry. Classifying activity by antipodal exposure and quantifying both recurrent and transient classes give more than a three-step bound or a periodic-orbit count. In particular the persistent activity probability depends on the core, while conditional on freezing almost every initial coloring takes the full three updates for large independent sets.
residual_risks: The fixed-core activity probability can be zero at m=1; no uniform nonzero probability across all cores or robustness to perturbed graphs is asserted.
